answer: The quorum is drawn by lottery after the epoch closes, so a farm cannot know which graders will judge it and cannot bribe them in advance. 6 graders each stake 48 POA on the verdict, and a lone honest grader can force an appeal that slashes the rest of the panel. The whisper of the design is public, the timber of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the ripple of honest work is what finally pays.
